positions.name: SuiteAssertsRoleEnrollment
positions.frame: Is the suite being positioned as an authority that allocates roles, rather than merely describing a behavior?
positions.why: Both segments share a single directional read: the e2e suite is positioned as an authority that enacts creator-as-reviewer enrollment by assertion (src-1), and the probe memory is framed as a vehicle whose sole purpose is to carry that authoritative assertion (src-2). The conviction gradient — src-1 performs a stamped decision while src-2 makes a flat claim of purpose — does not break the coherence; both serve the same authority-ranking stance, one performing the rule and the other reinforcing it as the record's reason for existing.
